curation.name: Moonwalk Backward
curation.summary: Moonwalk-style backward gliding gait with alternating feet and stable upright torso, finishing in standing; generated with Microduck Motion Lab.
curation.details: No machine-readable policy manifest is published with this artifact, so runtime facts remain unknown. The publisher task is Mjlab-MotionLabMoonwalkBackward-Flat-MicroDuck (velocity recipe, 4000 PPO iterations); its deployment checks report a needs-review motion-quality gate with semantic match explicitly unverified. Upstream metadata declares no license, so reuse needs maintainer review.
curation.notes: No manifest is published and upstream metadata declares no license; the ONNX interface is inspected only. The publisher's own quality gate needs review and the semantic match is unverified. The registry records no independent hardware evidence.

publisher_hardware.note: The publisher reports a headless CPU MuJoCo deployment rehearsal only and no physical MicroDuck deployment evidence.
